analysis.session_summary: The window from Friday close through Asia reopen was catalyst-light and flow-driven. CAD's CPI miss was the only high-impact release, causing a brief USD/CAD pop; otherwise most zigzag legs lacked clear catalysts. AUD led and JPY lagged, with AUD +0.36% and JPY -0.267%. De-escalation headlines were present but too weak to own moves, leaving positioning and risk appetite as the tape's main drivers.

themes.evidence: Most zigzag legs marked no cause; nearest items 'too weak to own the move' across EUR/USD, USD/JPY, GBP/USD and others.

themes.theme: CAD CPI miss produced sharp but contained USD/CAD reaction
themes.evidence: CPI actual 0.1% vs forecast 0.2%; USD/CAD +0.18% on event with sigma 8.07, yet CAD strength rank 2.
AUD +0.36%, NZD +0.188%, JPY -0.267%; AUD/USD +31.5 pips, USD/JPY +27.4 pips.
